sources.name: LADOTD crash database (managed by LSU CARTS; Louisiana Crash Tool / CAT-Scan)
sources.access: gated (access request to DOTDCrashData@LA.gov; DOTD Highway Safety Section grants access)
sources.years: statewide; a year is preliminary until DOTD closes it, about 8 months after year end
sources.gps_share: not measured (DOTD map-spots crashes: dotd_latit/dotd_longi in the file)
sources.keys_linkable: crash / vehicle / pedestrian / DOTD tables by crash number (LTRC FR 721)

sources.name: City of New Orleans 'Traffic Incidents 2019_2024' (the city's Traffic Safety Dashboard layer)
sources.gps_share: point geometry on every row (lat/lon not checked for plausibility)

sources.name: Baton Rouge Traffic Crash Incidents (Socrata 7wah-qncc)
sources.keys_linkable: crash-level only (incident_number); has_injury / has_fatality flags, no KABCO

placement_sample.area: Orleans Parish (22071), 2019, LADOTD file layout (consultant's public copy of the DOTD file, measurement only)
placement_sample.house_address_share: not measured (the DOTD layout has no house-number field)

blockers: LADOTD crash records need an access grant from the DOTD Highway Safety Section (DOTDCrashData@LA.gov)
DOTD marks every crash product 'exempt from discovery or admission under 23 U.S.C. 407'; no reuse terms published
no published export column list; la-column-map.json is built from the field names seen in consultants' public copies
user_actions: Email DOTDCrashData@LA.gov asking for Louisiana Crash Tool access, or a statewide crash / vehicle / person extract 2020-2024 (CSV, with dotd_latit/dotd_longi, primary road, intersecting road, distance, unit and direction)
Ask DOTD in writing whether the extract may be used inside a paid tool
Send Engineering one extract (one parish, one year) with its data dictionary to confirm la-column-map.json
